summary: eslint-plugin-folder-schema preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex identifiers, per-function string dictionary, array-rotation decoder) and downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub's oven-sh releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled blob (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) consisting of a single obfuscated line with a large numeric/string constant table and an array-rotation deobfuscator — no source, no documentation, no connection to the advertised ESLint-plugin purpose. The package metadata claims ServiceTitan / github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint as upstream, and lib/index.js contains a plausible ESLint rule, but the preinstall dropper and math_init.js payload are not present in that upstream, indicating a hijacked or typosquat release. Using an alternate JS runtime to execute an obfuscated compiled blob at install time hands arbitrary code execution to whoever authored math_init.js on every install and bypasses Node-based inspection of the payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
